writes the NetworkManager profiles /etc/NetworkManager/system-connections/VPN1 and VPN3 (OpenVPN, password auth, password-flags=0; VPN1 to the peer's server 203.0.113.50 with the throwaway CA, VPN3 to 203.0.113.9) and VPN4 (password-flags=1, permissions=user:p8testuser:;) and reloads NetworkManager; writes the stub /var/tmp/p8test-kd/kdialog (replays /var/tmp/p8test-kd/answers, logs to /var/tmp/p8test-kd/calls)

installs openvpn on the peer if absent; adds 203.0.113.50/32 to its enp0s8; writes /etc/p8test-vpnpw (the handed-over CA, server certificate and key, the accepted password p8test-pass-a, a check script comparing the user and password with it, server.conf: tun, UDP 1194, subnet 10.198.0.0/24, no client certificate); starts the server as a daemon logging to /run/p8test-vpnpw-server.log
